I waited a while to post this review. This place is horrible and unorganized. They asked us to get X-rays of our cat before a teeth cleaning because they thought he had dental issues. We took him in for his shots, and the front desk person was extremely rude, when we asked about his teeth we were told "I overlooked it."  We called back a few times because we were worried and about his health and every time they were rude, and could not find his records. We gave them the X-rays and they either didn't know how to read them or overlooked the mass in his lungs. We found out when we went to a different vet and they were upset that our cat was intubated with the mass in his lungs. The vet called for his records and Delta is so unorganized that they sent the records of someone else's dog, along with the owner's phone number and address mixed in with the records of our cat. And the records of our cat weren't even complete because they misplaced them. I would avoid this place at all costs. Absolutely horrible.

Edit: In response to the reply from this veterinary location. This is a perfect example of their disorganization. We went 3 times. And each time we asked them to update the name on the file, and to add my name to our pet's file. It looks like they never did even after we were told by two different people that it was updated.

I have had cats, and two dogs, throughout my life. Almost every one was treated at Delta Animal Hospital. Early on, we worked with Dr. Joseph Luka, later with his daughter Leslie. Both are wonderful veterinarians, and remarkably good at diagnosing illnesses other vets seem to miss. We have had to have 3 cats euthanized at the end of their lie, and they did so with a heavy heart and a lot of compassion. More important was how healthy they kept our cats throughout their lives. Their prices are far more reasonable than all the other vets around, perhaps, in part, because you aren't paying for all the fancy office space. Bring your patience, because being a walkin hospital, they can get extremely busy. I recently paid $50 for an examination of my sick cat, having spent $104 at Bond Vet the previous day, where the doctor totally missed an ear infection. The estimate at Bond came out to just over $1,000 for initial treatment and blood tests. I spent a total of $270 at Delta Animal Hospital with Dr. Leslie. I have also had bad experiences at VCA Animal Hospitals. The misdiagnosed my cat with an ear infection and missed a brain tumour. $7,000 later our cat needlessly suffered for months and we had to euthanize him at Village West Veterinary. It was horrible. Thank you to Dr. Leslie, her dad, Dr. Luka and the staff at Delta for all you do. Hopefully we can get our cat back to full health.

She hung up and as I sat down with my severely ill cat wrapped up this woman came all the way to the door and told me to get up and close the door, I didn't realize I left it cracked open, but this woman literally stood by the door and told me to get up and close the door! She already had hollered at me saying there are people ahead of me which was understood because we called last minute and were grateful for being taken in. The wait time was then vaguely extended, leading me to choose another vet. The lack of clear communication and the hostile attitude of the reception staff are appalling, and I can no longer trust my pet's care to this facility.
